caption: The drawing depicts a floor-length, short-sleeved dress rendered in pale, neutral tones, predominantly off-white or cream with delicate grey shading. The dress features a wide, square neckline bordered with a ruffled lace collar, decorated with small repeated motifs along the trim. The short sleeves are puffed and finished with a ruffle and similarly patterned trim. Just below the bust, an empire waistline is accentuated with a band which has a subtle, patterned edge. The long skirt falls straight and is adorned, down the front and along the seams, with symmetrical vertical rows of small leaf-like or petal motifs. The hemline is lavishly decorated with a thick band of clustered fabric flowers or rosettes, each with petal and leaf shapes in softly shaded whites and creams with hints of yellow and beige in the centers. Off to the right, a smaller, less detailed sketch shows the back view of the dress, where the ruffled collar and hem embellishments continue, and two long back ties are visible. The drawing is made with light pencil and ink outlines, and gentle washes of watercolor to indicate color and texture. The background is a plain, lightly yellowed or aged paper.
title: Evening Dress
